detail: The Royal Monetary Authority of Bhutan's Annual Audited Accounts for the year ended 30 June 2004 (Annexes X and XI: Statements of Condition for the Banking and Issue Divisions, and the Income and Expenditure Statement) carry the auditors' name as M/s P.K. Mitra & Company, Chartered Accountants, Kolkata, India, each statement stating that it is referred to in the auditors' report of even date. The auditor's report itself is not reproduced in the annual report text; the firm's name is printed on the face of the audited statements.
source_title: Royal Monetary Authority of Bhutan, Annual Report 2003/04 (Annual Audited Accounts of the RMA for 2003/2004, Annexes X-XI)

detail: The Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe's 2019 Annual Report states in its Directors' Report that the Bank's financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2019 were audited by Ernst & Young. No signing office or city is printed with the name. Separately, for the year ended 31 December 2024 BDO Zimbabwe audited only the Bank's gold balance (not the full financial statements), reporting 'We have audited the gold balance of the Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe as at 31 December 2024'.
source_title: Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe Annual Report 2019 (Directors' Report)

auditor: Societe FMBZ - KPMG Tunisie and Societe Cabinet C.M.C (joint)
detail: Joint audit. The Rapport des commissaires aux comptes in the Banque Centrale de Tunisie's Rapport Annuel 2025 covers 'les etats financiers arretes au 31 decembre 2025' and is dated Tunis, 30 March 2026. It is signed by two co-commissaires aux comptes, printed as Societe FMBZ / KPMG Tunisie and Societe Cabinet C.M.C, with individual signatories Mohamed Imed LOUKIL and Hichem AMOURI. The extracted text prints FMBZ and KPMG Tunisie as separate entries; FMBZ-KPMG Tunisie is one member firm and is recorded as one.
source_title: Banque Centrale de Tunisie, Rapport Annuel 2025 - Etats financiers et rapport des commissaires aux comptes
